question: Determine whether shared joint action stationarity and flat preparation select half-stock fold closure.
assumptions: Common-rate aligned oscillator and empty records.
Symmetric hinges with positive inertia and stiffness.

target_exposure: First directed half-stock hold target established in C06 v0.16–v0.17
fitted_choices: Counterexample action family; no empirical fit
